nodes.text: #BREAKING 🇮🇳 ICMR has confirmed two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Karnataka, detected via routine respiratory surveillance. This is part of ICMR's ongoing monitoring for respiratory pathogens, according to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. #HMPV https://t.co/5BwHP4wzc6
